name: waiting-state
title: Waiting State
description: A deploy progress narrator with zero percentage bars: a connector line fills only as each real step actually completes, a live elapsed clock ticks on the active step, and watch "Building assets" run genuinely long, past its own typical estimate, triggering a calm "taking a little longer than usual" note instead of a bar that quietly stalls and lies. Every finished step keeps its real measured duration on screen.
